name.fr-FR: Statuts et Constitutions de la Congrégation de Jésus et Marie
name.en-US: Statutes and Constitutions of the Congregation of Jesus and Mary
name.pt-BR: Estatutos e Constituições da Congregação de Jesus e Maria

description.fr-FR: Les Constitutions françaises de la Congrégation de Jésus et Marie, en treize parties, avec l’introduction historique de l’édition de 1909.
description.en-US: The French Constitutions of the Congregation of Jesus and Mary, in thirteen parts, with the historical introduction of the 1909 edition.
description.pt-BR: As Constituições francesas da Congregação de Jesus e Maria, em treze partes, com a introdução histórica da edição de 1909.

fr-FR.editor: Charles Lebrun, Ange Le Doré, Joseph Dauphin (Congrégation de Jésus et Marie)

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du Vénérable Jean Eudes, tome 9, Vannes (Lafolye) et Paris (Beauchesne), 1905–1911, éd. Ch. Lebrun, A. Le Doré, J. Dauphin; transcription Bibliothèque Saint Libère (liberius.net), 2008.
sources.description: Born-digital transcription of the 1905–11 edition, converted by script: page markers and running heads removed, hyphenation and leaked letter-spacing repaired, paragraphs rejoined; the editors’ footnotes are gathered at the end of the file where they fall; footnote call numbers stay in the running text. The editors’ introductions are kept.
sources.tierEvidence: Eudes died in 1680; the 1905–11 edition is public domain.
